verdict: Null on size: states where turnout grew more than average tended to see the Democrat beat the polls (correlation +0.25), but adding turnout to a poll-only estimate did not reliably cut the error (RMSE 2.85 to 2.77 points, interval includes zero).
summary: 165 Senate and governor races, 2016-2024 (four cycles). Turnout is known only after the election, and the early-vote version has just 8 races on disk, so there is no usable live signal.
